## ÉTAT DU SECTEUR
Le secteur on-chain (catégorie DeFiLlama 'RWA', 189 protocoles) affiche une TVL de 3,73 Md$, en baisse de -4,58% sur 7 jours à 12h40 UTC. - **Sécurité et confiance (Binance)** : Binance a subi des sorties nettes de 5,3 Md$ suite à un piratage record. Ce signal de clarté réglementaire, couplé à l'activité de TSV sous une exemption à l'innovation de la SEC, soutient la thèse d'un cadre juridique en cours de consolidation pour les titres tokenisés.
- **Contrôle émetteur (SpaceX)** : SpaceX a bloqué une listing d'actions tokenisées sur OKXICE. Cette action illustre la tension entre l'innovation DeFi et le contrôle des émetteurs sur leurs titres, rappelant que la tokenisation des actions reste soumise à la gouvernance des entreprises hors chaîne.

## ÉTAT ON-CHAIN
Chain TVL stands at **$1.056B**, recording a daily decline of **-3.1%**. The trajectory indicates a cooling from the early-November highs near $1.13B, establishing a new consolidation floor around the $1.06B mark. Capital concentration remains elevated; the top 3 protocols—Morpho Blue ($578M), Steakhouse Financial ($512M), and Uniswap V4 ($162M)—command approximately **76%** of total TVL. This high concentration, particularly within risk-curation (Steakhouse) and lending (Morpho), suggests a capital profile that is sophisticated but potentially sticky to launch-incentivized yields rather than organic retail flow.

*   **Uniswap Infrastructure Expansion (Product):** The extension of Uniswap's VolatilePair Hook and the opening of the fee conversion tool TJAR to Robinhood Chain (The Defiant, The Block) directly supports the **$162M TVL** in Uniswap V4. While not an on-chain inflow, this validates the "regulated entry" thesis, potentially stabilizing the broader capital structure.

This friction likely contributes to the **-3.1% TVL dip**, as risk-off sentiment permeates the tokenized equity sector, pressuring liquidity pools exposed to these assets.
*   **Traditional Finance Convergence (Regulatory):** The NYSE/Broadridge partnership to bring shareholder voting to tokenized stocks (CoinDesk) underscores the structural shift towards on-chain equity. For Robinhood Chain, this validates the 24/7 tokenized stock use case, even as current market sentiment adjusts to regulatory pushback elsewhere.

The -3.1% TVL correction reflects the market's sensitivity to regulatory friction, evidenced by the issuer objections to OKX-ICE. The chain's value proposition is not speculative yield farming, but the compliant tokenization of real-world assets (RWAs) and equities. The persistence of high TVL ($1.05B) despite the RWA backlash indicates that "sticky" capital prefers the regulatory safety of a broker-dealer chain over unjurisdictioned alternatives. The regime favors protocols that can navigate compliance (Uniswap, Morpho) while penalizing those that rely on speculative tokenization of contested assets.

## VALUE WATCH - 2026-11-06

## MOUVEMENTS DE MULTIPLES
Lending sector median P/F expanded to 3.92x (from 3.6x), driven by a fundamental leg: Maple Finance fees surged 2.14% 7d and Morpho fees up 3.27% 7d. Maple Finance re-rates to 1.01x P/F (Rank 1), maintaining a 74% discount to the sector median. In DEX, the sector median P/F compressed to 3.12x (from 3.05x) on a fundamental leg: Meteora fees collapsed 26.03% 7d, Orca down 17.39% 7d, and Raydium down 22.02% 7d. Meteora remains the absolute cheapest DEX at 0.74x P/F (Rank 1), trading at a 76% discount to peers.

## WATCHLIST
Maple Finance (SYRUP) trades at a 74% discount to the lending sector median with a P/F of 1.01x (Rank 1). Token capture is currently 10.0%, yielding a P/HR of 37.7x. Base trend shows fees up 2.14% 7d. FDV/Mcap is clean at 1.09x.

Token capture is null (capture_pct=0), rendering the P/S thesis open until value accrual is confirmed. FDV/Mcap of 1.77x invalidates the mcap multiple; use FDV framing. Fees declined 26.03% 7d.

## THESES
Maple Finance: CONFIRM - P/F expanded slightly to 1.01x (from 0.93x) on continued fee growth of 2.14% 7d, maintaining the value thesis with active token capture.
Meteora: REVISE - P/F compressed to 0.74x (from 0.75x) as fees collapsed 26.03% 7d, weakening the fundamental divergence thesis further.
Orca: REVISE - P/F compressed to 1.11x (from 1.13x) but fees declined 17.39% 7d, reducing the positive fundamental divergence signal.
Aerodrome: NEW - Exceptional token capture at 96.1% with a P/HR of 1.7x supports a value thesis despite FDV/Mcap of 5.74x requiring FDV framing.

Maple Finance: Token capture drops below 5% or P/F expands above 1.5x.
Meteora: FDV/Mcap exceeds 2.0x or fees decline >50% 7d.

v.note_evaluation: La condition est decoupee sur ses « ou » et CHAQUE membre porte ses propres nombres. La clause de SEUIL se note quand on a la valeur ; la clause de DUREE se note quand la condition nomme une base dont on possede la serie quotidienne — sinon elle reste NON EVALUABLE et le dit, sans repli sur une autre base. Une clause de PERSISTANCE (« reste a X % pendant N jours ») n'est jamais notee : on a la capture du jour, pas son historique — on ecrit seulement si le niveau de declenchement est atteint. La capture vient du board et annualise 24 h : un verdict proche du seuil est marque fragile. Un seuil de 7 baisses consecutives est rare mais pas hors d'atteinte : mesure sur 365 jours, jamais atteint sur le volume d'Orca ni de Raydium (max 6), atteint une fois sur la TVL de Spark (7) et de Lista DAO (8).
v.note: 193 verdicts sur 79 briefs redigés, du 2026-07-10 au 2026-11-06.
